findings.evidence: Enriched process SFT cleared implementation, paired-counterfactual and missing-safe minima; coarse projection still contains intentional collisions.
findings.implication: Collect the missing abstract request/observation condition before increasing model size or RL steps.

findings.evidence: Final-only SFT reaches post classification but ask_rate and missing-safe rate are zero.
findings.implication: Persist pre-state, question, returned observation, failure, next action and belief transition.

findings.evidence: Family-held-out pre-question gate passes while family post metrics remain weak; the shared question role transfers, exact family slot binding does not.
findings.implication: Do not report this fixture as vulnerability discovery; PG-279 must add real local replay records and source-held-out retention.

findings.evidence: DPO preserves headline transition metrics but its missing-observation safe minimum is zero.
findings.implication: Keep conservative/SFT anchors and gate on per-seed safety minima, not mean reward.

interpretation: PG-278 passes independent integrity and controlled process-supervision gates on four synthetic loopback families. It proves that enriched observation fields are necessary for this experiment and exposes final-only/DPO failure modes. It does not authorize training or memory promotion and does not establish real-target vulnerability capability.
